reviews.text: I've been bringing my dog ​​here for 6 years. Dr. Roberta is very knowledgeable, thorough, and always greets us and our furry friends with a smile. The office is clean, and the staff is attentive to all our needs. Highly recommended.

I wanted to compliment the clinic, first of all Dr. Rinaldo Carolina who is very competent and with her my Zak doesn't make any fuss! The same goes for Elena, very sweet and helpful! My little dog has diabetes but they are giving him a makeover! This morning we put the sensor in to monitor my blood sugar! Thank you so much Chiara, the anxious mother

We brought our new kitten to this clinic after some unpleasant experiences with our previous practice, which had undermined our trust.
It was an unexpectedly positive turn of events: we found professionalism, kindness, and genuine concern for the animal's well-being.
The doctor and her staff welcomed us with understanding and helpfulness, making us feel immediately at ease and restoring the peace of mind we had lost.

It was an experience that truly reconciled us with our trust in those who care for our little companions.

I've been bringing my cat to this clinic for a year now, and I couldn't have made a better choice. The doctors are not only professional, but also very helpful and compassionate, always ready to help and reassure you. I immediately trusted them because of their knowledge, their willingness to explain, and their willingness to involve you in the process. As the owner of my ginger cat, I immediately felt understood and guided with care and patience. Overall, I highly recommend them!

I have a cat named Simba, and he's a patient at this wonderful clinic. From my first visit, I was able to observe not only great professionalism and expertise, but above all, a great sense of humanity: the doctors are always available and ready to lend a hand at any time, and each animal is treated as if it were their own. For this, I thank them so much and will always recommend this veterinary clinic!
Dr. Carolina and her entire team are empathetic and professional, and all the visits went well: attention to both the dog and the human, clear explanations, and above all, careful follow-up.
Availability, empathy and professionalism
An excellent clinic

If it had been possible, I would have given zero stars.
I'll just say that three years ago I took my dog ​​because he had a bad cough that wouldn't go away. He had an ultrasound and was told he had a tumor in his spleen that needed emergency surgery, otherwise he could have internal bleeding and die within a week.
Three years have passed, and luckily my dog ​​is still here with me. They gave him up for dead within a week, all to get me to accept an operation that would probably only benefit them, since my dog ​​was 14 years old and I didn't feel like subjecting him to such an invasive procedure, as he probably wouldn't have survived.
They certainly care about animals, but I think they care about other things, which is why they created such a panic with me that, thanks to them, I was sick for two months because I lived with the anxiety that I could lose my dog ​​any day.
So my experience was definitely NEGATIVE.

Oscar was a patient at this veterinary clinic for 14 years. Dr. Roberta, Dr. Carolina, and the sweet Elena always cared for him and cared for him in a special way, just as he cared for me.
I want to thank everyone, including Anderson, who often had to deal with my anxieties and fears when I requested an emergency appointment.
I embrace them all with affection, wishing all the dogs and cats to be their patients.
Attentive and caring staff, who with patience and care, managed a problem with a non-absorbable stitch that was literally driving my small but very elderly dog ​​crazy!!!!!!

My little dog has been a patient at this wonderful clinic for 14 years. Doctors Roberta Lucà and Carolina Rinaldo, like all the staff, are driven by a sincere and deep love for their patients. What struck me was their humanity. I lost my little dog a few days ago, and the doctors committed to doing everything they could until his last day, providing him with the best care and providing me with enormous moral support, as if the dog were truly their own. For this reason, I will always hold them in my heart. If you want to trust people who are not only highly experienced, but also willing to go the extra mile and always support you, trust me, this is the right place.

I had a very positive experience at this veterinary clinic. I had brought my cat in with a misdiagnosis from another clinic: an abscess on his flank that had developed within a few days and was diagnosed as a lipoma, which was therefore left untreated. The doctor was quick to diagnose the cat's true problem and immediately proceeded with the most appropriate treatment, supported by cutting-edge laser therapy. Today, a month after the last treatment, the problem has not recurred, so I can confidently say that the cat has made a complete recovery. I thank the doctors and staff at the clinic for their expertise, which, combined with their extreme kindness, form a perfect blend of professionalism. Sincerely, Sabrina Santoro

Super positive experience! My mixed breed Zed had a minor operation for a wound on his ear. Dr. Rinaldo and her entire staff immediately took care of my dog ​​Zed in a very professional and humane manner.
Welcoming and professional environment, knowledgeable, very kind and reassuring doctor. I recommend a visit to anyone concerned about their furry friend. 😍 …
Excellent clinic, experience, friendliness and friendly courtesy!!! 😘😘😘😘😘 …
My dog, Jack, is over 16 years old and has reached this age thanks to the staff at the clinic. They have always cared for him and helped him with professionalism and affection.

My French bulldog is 8 years old and has been cared for by the doctors at Cilea since the very beginning. I've felt safe with them in every situation: from vaccinations to ear infections, from a controlled and balanced homemade diet to regular preventive care. It's thanks to Dr. Rinaldo's dedication that I discovered a tumor in my dog. The tumor is inoperable due to its location, but finding it early is allowing me to treat her. I highly recommend you trust them.

Dr. Rinaldo examined my Labrador for an ear infection.
The experience was very positive because I found her to be very thorough and professional, along with gentle treatment of the dog and a willingness to explain. The assistant was also very kind and helpful. Thank you!

A center where I immediately found empathy and kindness. Not to mention their professionalism; they immediately identified the problem, both with my first kitten and the second. They are very willing to help with any emergencies. I recommend it 100%!

Best staff in naples and amazing groomer our . Amazingly helpful with any questions or concerns. They treat our dog like their own. Can communicate in English as well. They go above and beyond to take care of us.
5 stars all the way
Excellent impression, very kind doctor, I also really appreciated the appointment that was given to me on Sunday for Monday via WhatsApp.
Dr. Carolina is top-notch, always kind and professional. And even though my tiger made her "try out" her evil claw before the blood sample was taken, she was always affectionate and sweet.

Today, more than ever, I thank Dr. Luca and her entire staff. Our dog's situation wasn't easy, but it's precisely in these difficult times that true professionals and their experience shine through. …
